number.description: Assign a sequential integer identifier if generating a batch, or default to null if extracting a single standalone record.

global_identifier.description: Extract the unique alphanumeric symbol of the derivative warrant. In the Thai term sheet, this is denoted as 'ชื่อย่อ' (e.g., 'ADVANC01P2607A' or 'COM701C2607B').2

date_filed.description: The date the prospectus was filed with the SEC. If not explicitly stated in the abbreviated term sheet, return null. Do not hallucinate filing dates.

cusip.description: The Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures 9-character alphanumeric code. As Thai domestic DWs typically do not utilize CUSIPs, this must structurally default to null.6

isin.description: The International Securities Identification Number. Extract if available; otherwise, return null.

issuer.description: Extract the full legal name of the issuing entity and translate to English. For the provided documents, this maps to 'ผู้ออกใบสำคัญแสดงสิทธิอนุพันธ์ฯ' and must be output exactly as 'Bualuang Securities Public Company Limited'.2

distributor.description: Default to the identical value extracted for the 'issuer' parameter, as the issuer acts as its own direct listing distributor on the SET.2

initial_valuation_date.description: Extract the date used to determine the initial reference price. If not explicitly isolated from the issue date, return null.

initial_valuation_dates.description: Extract if applicable, otherwise set to null.

multiple_initial_valuation_dates_style.description: Set strictly to null. Vanilla DWs do not utilize multiple initial valuation averaging styles.

multiple_initial_valuation_dates_first_d.description: Set strictly to null. Do not populate with 1899-12-31 epoch artifacts.

issue_date.description: Extract the issuance date ('วันออกใบสำคัญแสดงสิทธิอนุพันธ์ฯ'). Convert Thai BE dates to Gregorian DD/MM/YYYY (e.g., '6 กุมภาพันธ์ 2569' becomes '06/02/2026').2

trade_date.description: Identical to issue_date for Direct Listing (Direct Listing) SET DWs, representing the first day of exchange trading.2 Format as DD/MM/YYYY.

offering_closes.description: The date the subscription period ends. For direct market listings lacking a discrete subscription window, return null.

strike_date.description: The date the strike price was finalized. Often mirrors the date the Black-Scholes pricing was run (e.g., 4 February 2026).2 Format as DD/MM/YYYY or null if ambiguous.

final_valuation_date.description: Extract the last trading day ('วันทำการซื้อขายสุดท้าย'). Format as DD/MM/YYYY.2

final_valuation_dates.description: Extract if applicable, otherwise set to null.

multiple_final_valuation_dates_style.description: Set strictly to null. European exercise prohibits multiple final valuation averaging (Asian option style).

maturity_date.description: Extract the maturity date ('วันครบกำหนดอายุ'). Format as DD/MM/YYYY.2

principal_amount.description: Extract the absolute total offering value ('มูลค่ารวมที่เสนอขาย') without currency symbols (e.g., 40000000.00 for the ADVANC Put).2

proportional_principal_amount.description: Set to null or a default integer if required by the legacy schema (e.g., 1 or 10).6

investment_type.description: Hardcode as 'Growth', indicating the product is engineered for capital appreciation rather than income generation.2

document_type.description: Hardcode as 'Final' to indicate these are finalized, non-draft pricing term sheets.2

product_subtype.description: Determine the option directionality. If the document states 'สิทธิในการซื้อ' (Right to buy), output 'Call Warrant'. If it states 'สิทธิในการขาย' (Right to sell), output 'Put Warrant'.2

fixed_income_type.description: Extract if applicable, otherwise set to null.

underlying_ticker.description: Identify the underlying asset ('หลักทรัพย์อ้างอิง'). Determine its standard SET symbol and append ' TB Equity' to format it as a valid Bloomberg ticker (e.g., 'COM7 TB Equity', 'CPF TB Equity').2

multiple_underlyings.description: Determine if the instrument is linked to a basket of assets. For vanilla single-stock DWs, this must be false or null.

expiry_payment_date.description: Mirror the maturity_date, as settlement occurs precisely upon expiration.

updated_at.description: Generate the current ISO 8601 timestamp, identical to created_at.
